epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local setup time from >15 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack and expose a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose file, so that the full stack can be launched locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root without docker-compose,
When a developer runs docker-compose up,
Then the full stack starts successfully and a health-check endpoint is accessible,
And E2E testing confirms the application is reachable.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce full stack startup failures from >10% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to perform material update or deletion from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Implement UI actions to update and delete existing epidemiological materials

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions to the existing UI, so that the cataloging functionality is complete without outdated entries.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system,
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI,
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding API endpoint and the catalog is updated accordingly,
And E2E tests confirm the material is successfully updated or removed from the view.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to complete UI material update or deletion from >5 mins to <1 min

epics.title: Knowledge Base Authentication
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents to restricted data from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Implement authentication check to block unauthenticated access to the catalog and material creation

slices.title: Implement authentication block for catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to add an authentication check, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user,
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material,
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in,
And integration tests confirm that unauthorized requests are rejected.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated successful requests from >0% to 0%
